release_notes: Ban 0.0.23: doi cach dong goi sang dang THU MUC (exe + _internal) nen moi lan mo app khong con tu giai nen ~257 MB vao %TEMP% — khoi dong nhanh hon va bot bi Defender/antivirus bao nham. Goi phat hanh la file .zip; cap nhat trong app tu tai goi, chi thay exe + _internal, GIU NGUYEN quan_ly_hoa_don.db, thu muc QUAN_LY_HOA_DON, logs va update_config.json. Ban .exe don van duoc dinh kem de nguoi dung dang chay 0.0.22 cap nhat duoc. Thay opencv-python bang opencv-python-headless (−8 MB). Khong con ky bang chung chi self-signed (chu ky do Windows khong tin, chi lam canh bao trong te hon).
